name: clonamic-task-log
description: Turn your own git work in the current project into a dated, portfolio-ready Korean work log with one explicit /clonamic-task-log command: local log files plus Notion pages, with importance scoring, estimated feature progress, and a redaction gate that keeps file names and secrets out.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your own git work into a portfolio-ready Korean work log on an explicit command.
interface.longDescription: One command, /clonamic-task-log, collects your own commits in the current project, filters noise with stated reasons, scores importance, estimates feature progress, and writes a dated Korean work log locally and to Notion. A redaction gate keeps file names, paths, hashes, and secrets out. Each project keeps its own log.
defaultPrompt: Use Clonamic Task Log to log my work in this project.
